title: Actual finite-Q3 local Duhamel-word incidence and degree escalation
question: Does a concrete local word built from the canonical Q3 onsite and one spatial-bond potential have a nonzero source coefficient of degree 4m-3?

model.onsite_restriction: Set the three Q3 neighbours of species 000 to zero; the onsite plus incident-lock quartic is G*q^4/4 with G=g+3*lambda.
model.position_sum: m times the ordered word, representing the m possible bond-insertion positions in the commuting multiplication word

scoped_verdict: The selected local word is an actual polynomial word of the canonical Q3 split: its ordered coefficient is -c*(-G/4)^(m-1)*a^(4m-3), and the position sum is m times this nonzero coefficient for the fixture.
open_after_test: cancellation or reinforcement among all Duhamel words
full eight-component onsite flow and all bond orientations
factorial history resummation with a source/energy topology
volume-uniform all-shape exhaustion Cauchy and common alpha
KMS, ground/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A

adversarial_review.check: The restricted onsite polynomial and selected bond are derived from the canonical Q3 lock and spatial quadratic, so the word is an actual local split word.
Setting other species and sites to zero proves a local coefficient witness only; it does not evaluate the full lattice history.
The m-position factor is a multiplication-word combinatorial sum, not a claim that all operator orderings have the same full-series sign after dynamics.
No cancellation theorem is inferred from a nonzero local word coefficient.
R220 checks only the rational degree and coefficient fixtures, not operator domains or history convergence.
No thermodynamic dynamics, OS/KMS construction, GNS gap, continuum limit, C6 or Pre-A conclusion follows.

scope.closed: Exact local Q3 word incidence and nonzero source-degree formula for the declared onsite-plus-one-bond word.
scope.not_closed: The full Q3 history, full-series cancellation, two-orientation resummation, all-shape exhaustion, common alpha, KMS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

next_action: Use this actual local word as a coefficient witness in a full signed Duhamel expansion; prove cancellation or derive an entire/source-weighted resummation before any common-alpha or QFT promotion.
no_overclaim: This package proves an actual local polynomial word coefficient only. It does not prove that the complete Q3 series retains that coefficient after all words, nor Q3 dynamics, a thermodynamic QFT, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
